title: Club Membership: when a past-due membership may be administratively closed
content:
## Scope
This document states the basis on which Club Membership administratively closes a membership contract that has remained past due.

## Per-tier grace period
| Tier | Grace period before administrative closure |
|---|---|
| Base Club Access | 15 calendar days |
| Student Metro Access | 15 calendar days |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | 15 calendar days |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | 15 calendar days |
| Premier All-Access | 20 calendar days |
| Black Card All-Access | 20 calendar days |
| Founding Legacy Access | 30 calendar days |

## Eligibility: the grace period must have elapsed
A membership contract sitting in past due status may be administratively closed only once the tier's own grace period has elapsed since the membership was marked past due. The clock starts from the system's own recorded date the contract was marked past due, and the grace period is counted as full calendar days from that date, with no partial-day rounding; the boundary day itself counts as satisfied. The closure may not be recorded at a moment earlier than that anchor date plus the tier's own grace period.

## Points of judgement
A contract marked past due whose grace period, counted in full calendar days from the recorded past-due date, has not yet run its complete length may not be administratively closed; once that full length has run, including the boundary day itself, the closure may be recorded.
